response.text: Your goal is to fix the n8n workflow so the full file of about 5,000 rows lands every night with retries and a Slack message if it still fails. My plan: first, analyze the existing n8n workflow and identify the 429 Too Many Requests error causes in the Google Sheets node. Second, implement batching, rate limiting, and retry logic within the workflow to safely handle large CSV imports. I did nearly this for a lead intake automation: lead entry dropped from about 2 hours a week to under 10 minutes. What is the exact structure of the incoming CSV file and how is it currently split or processed in n8n? Let us chat about the full plan.
